source.title: Gelator Length Precisely Tunes Supramolecular Hydrogel Stiffness and Neuronal Phenotype in 3D Culture

material: PA-1 peptide amphiphile gel with K4 (oligo-L-lysine, n=4)

formulation.evidence: DA neurons cultured in 3D PA-1/K4 gels (14 DIV, 40,000 cells/μL, 0.5 wt % PA-1)
gelled the resulting solution with the chloride salts of K4 (10 mM), K10 (4 mM), or Ca2+ (20 mM) to create 3D gels

processing.evidence: annealed at 90 °C for 30 min, followed by a controlled temperature gradient of 0.5° C/min down to 25 °C to create long fibers

culture_days.evidence: DA neurons cultured in 3D PA-1/K4 gels (14 DIV, 40,000 cells/μL, 0.5 wt % PA-1)

viability_percent.evidence: At 14 DIV, this difference in viability between K4 and K10 was even more pronounced (K10 = 25%, K4 = 38%, p < 0.0001)

neurite_length.evidence: The average length of the longest neurite in PA-1/K4 gels was 95.0 ± 8.1 μm

other_outcomes.evidence: Stress relaxation is also independent of n (Figure 1G, T1/2:K4 = 110 s, K10 = 89 s, K15 = 124 s, p = 0.76)
other_outcomes.name: stress relaxation half-time

other_outcomes.evidence: PA-1/K4 gels proved better for cells as the percentage of TH+ neurons increased (Figure 5G−I,M75%)
other_outcomes.name: TH+ neurons percentage

survival.evidence: At 1 DIV, both Kn samples demonstrated increased survival compared to Ca2+ (30% for Ca2+, 43% for K10, and 50% for K4, p < 0.0001)
At 14 DIV, this difference in viability between K4 and K10 was even more pronounced (K10 = 25%, K4 = 38%, p < 0.0001)

notes: Softer gel (~70 Pa lower G′ than PA-1/K10).
